purpose: Licence inventory for the Java/Kotlin libraries and other non-media components bundled with Indagium. The native media closure (JavaCV, JavaCPP, FFmpeg, zstd-jni and everything they link) is maintained separately in licenses/third-party/media-components.json. Every module on desktopRuntimeClasspath must match a `modules` pattern here; validateApplicationLicenseInventory fails the build otherwise. licenseFiles are resource paths relative to licenses/.
